<!-- This removes the header "References" from the page -->

::: {#refs}
:::

```{r eval=TRUE}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
# Imports biblios from bib into tibble
bibs=bib2df::bib2df("citations.bib") # or come si chiama il tuo file
bibs=bibs |> 
  # Puts the authors' list into a single string, separated by commas
  rowwise() |> mutate(AUTHOR=paste(unlist(AUTHOR), collapse=", ")) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    # Makes your name in bold
    AUTHOR=stringr::str_replace(AUTHOR,"Blangiardo, Marta","<b>Blangiardo, Marta</b>"),
    # Formats the pages in a nicer way
    PAGES=stringr::str_replace(PAGES,"--","-"),
    PAGES=replace_na(PAGES,"")
  ) |> 
  # Creates a single string with the text to be included in the reference list
   mutate(
     string=case_when(
       # If the pages are not present in the bib file, then exclude them
       PAGES==""~paste0(AUTHOR,
                   " (",YEAR,"). ",
                   TITLE,
                   # This formats the journal in italics
                   ". <i>",JOURNAL, "</i>. ",
                   # This makes the URL a hyperlink
                   "<a href='",URL,"'>",URL,"</a>"),
       # If they are given, then just include them
       TRUE~paste0(AUTHOR,
                   " (",YEAR,"). ",
                   TITLE,
                   # This formats the journal in italics
                   ". <i>",JOURNAL, "</i>. ",
                   PAGES,". ",
                   # This makes the URL a hyperlink
                   "<a href='",URL,"'>",URL,"</a>")
     )
   )

# Now use DT::datatable to format they references by date and with searchable fields
bibs %>% dplyr::select(string,YEAR,CATEGORY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% arrange(desc(YEAR)) %>% 
  DT::datatable(
    class = list(stripe = FALSE),
    escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = c("RowGroup",'Select', 'SearchPanes'),
    # This allows for regex search
    selection = 'none',
    colnames = rep("", ncol(.)),
    options = list(
      info = FALSE,
      paging = FALSE,
      dom = 'Pfrtip',
      search = list(regex=TRUE, caseInsensitive=TRUE),
      searchPanes = list(initCollapsed=TRUE),
      language = list(lengthMenu = "_MENU_"),
      rowGroup=list(dataSrc=c(1)),
      pageLength = 200,
      columnDefs = list(
        list(
          visible=FALSE,targets=c(1,2)
        ),
        list(
          searchPanes = list(show = FALSE), targets = 0
        ),
        list(
          searchPanes = list(show=TRUE,header=c("Select Year")),targets=1
        ),
        list(
          searchPanes = list(show=TRUE,header=c("Select type")),targets=2
        )
      )
    )
  ) 
```
